ui.host.capcom.name: CAPCOM
ui.host.capcom.briefing.C1.1: Mission control, this is CAPCOM with your first contract: Earth Watch.
ui.host.capcom.briefing.C1.2: Your team will design and launch a 150 kg Earth-observation smallsat.
ui.host.capcom.briefing.C1.3: The target is a sun-synchronous orbit at 550 km, inclined about 97.6°, so every pass sees the ground at the same local time.
ui.host.capcom.briefing.C1.4: Getting there takes about {2} of Δv, on a budget of {3} and a schedule of {4}.
ui.host.capcom.briefing.C1.5: Once in orbit, the satellite must stay power-positive and capture as many science targets as it can.
ui.host.capcom.briefing.C1.6: Every part you choose has a cost in mass, power, money and days, so trade carefully.
ui.host.capcom.briefing.C1.7: The build opens with your vote. Good luck, team.
